Agenda
TYPE: Regular Board Meeting
DATE: 10/12/2026 TIME: 7:00 PM
Agenda Attachment
LOCATION: MVLA District Office Board Room, 1299 Bryant Avenue, Mountain View, CA 94040
DETAILS:
LINK: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OcCQV9ZuIWQ Closed Session will begin at 5:30 p.m., Study Session at 6:00 p.m., and Open Session will begin at 7:00 p.m. in the Board Room of the Mountain View Los Altos High School District Office located at 1299 Bryant Avenue, Mountain View, CA 94040. This meeting will be live-streamed through YouTube and members of the public may view it through the link posted on this agenda at the start of the meeting. Special notice: Anyone who is planning to attend this meeting and has any disability requiring special assistance is asked to call the Superintendent's Office, (650) 940-4650, X7011, at least 48 hours in advance in order for arrangements to be made. Anyone desiring Spanish translation is asked to call the Superintendent's Office, (650) 940-4650, X7011, at least 48 hours in advance in order for arrangements to be made. Cualquier persona que quiera traducción al español debe llamar a la Oficina del Superintendente, (650) 940-4650, X7011, con al menos 48 horas de anticipación para que se hagan los arreglos. Public Records: Any writings or documents that are public records and are provided to a majority of the Board of Education regarding an open session item on this agenda will be made available in the Superintendent's office for public inspection at the District Office located at 1299 Bryant Avenue, Mountain View, CA 94040 during normal business hours. Upon request by a student's parent/guardian, or by the student, 18 or older, the minutes shall not include the student's or parent/guardian's address, telephone number, date of birth, or email address, or the student's name or other directory information as defined in Education Code 49061. The request to exclude such information shall be made in writing to the Executive Assistant to the Superintendent and Board of Trustees. (Education Code 49073.2) Note: Additionally, if technical difficulties persist, this notice advises members of the public that the Board meeting will continue without broadcasting/streaming.
